description: Our Solid Color Short Sleeve Crew Neck T-Shirt is designed with comfort in mind, along with a casual, yet professional appearance. These lightweight t-shirts can be worn on their own, or under your uniform as a base layer undershirt. These breathable shirts are great for outdoor adventures, working-out, casual everyday use, professional workwear, and more! Rugged & Long-Lasting: Go ahead and wear your short sleeve shirt without a worry! The soft, yet durable cotton / polyester fabric blend easily withstands consistent use, while the fade-resistant color comfortably tackles machine washes. Action Ready: These crewneck tees consist of reinforced seams at the collar, sleeves, and bottom hem to further enhance the shirt’s durability. With a tag-less neck label, you’re free to move around without any itches or scratches. Standard Fit: These rugged t-shirts are standard fit, giving you room and flexibility for various activities, especially around the arms. Our t-shirts sit approximately at the waist for full coverage. We’ve Got You Covered: Pair your patriotic tee with one of our Tactical BDU Cargo Pants or Vintage Paratrooper Cargo Shorts.
